This issuer exhibits very large scale (Assets of $404B, Revenue of $36.4B) and strong profitability (80% gross margin, $5.0B operating income), but carries a substantial debt load as evidenced by total liabilities of $298.5B and a weak current ratio of 0.91. While the massive asset base and solid earnings support an investment-grade profile, the highly leveraged capital structure and tight short-term liquidity constrain the rating to the lower end of the upper-medium grade.

DECISION: A-
